mapper.select: /** 미결함 */ WITH first_pending_step AS ( SELECT apr04_appr_id , apr04_step_emp_id , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY apr04_appr_id ORDER BY apr04_seq) AS rn FROM apr04_appr_step INNER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = apr04_appr_id AND apr01_company_id = #{companyId} WHERE apr04_step_type_cd NOT IN ('00','30') AND apr04_step_status_cd = '10' ) SELECT a.apr01_appr_id AS appr_id , CASE WHEN f.apr04_step_emp_id = #{empId} OR alt.apr07_alt_emp_id = #{empId} THEN '승인대기' WHEN alt.apr07_stamp_yn = 'true' AND s.apr10_second_emp_id = #{empId} AND b.apr04_step_type_cd = '40' THEN '인감대기' ELSE '진행중' END AS status_name , a.apr01_reg_date::date AS reg_date , a.apr01_title AS title , f_emp_kor_nm(a.apr01_reg_emp_id) AS reg_emp_name FROM apr01_appr a INNER JOIN ( SELECT * FROM apr04_appr_step WHERE apr04_step_type_cd NOT IN ('00','30') AND apr04_step_status_cd NOT IN ('20','30') ) b ON a.apr01_appr_id = b.apr04_appr_id LEFT JOIN apr10_stamp s ON a.apr01_stamp_id = s.apr10_stamp_id LEFT JOIN first_pending_step f ON a.apr01_appr_id = f.apr04_appr_id AND f.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN apr07_alt_appr alt ON alt.apr07_target_emp_id = b.apr04_step_emp_id AND f_today() BETWEEN alt.apr07_start_date AND alt.apr07_close_date WHERE a.apr01_status_cd NOT IN ('30','40','99') AND a.apr01_reg_emp_id != #{empId} AND a.apr01_company_id = #{companyId} AND ( #{empId} = b.apr04_step_emp_id OR #{empId} = alt.apr07_alt_emp_id OR ( s.apr10_second_emp_id = #{empId} AND b.apr04_step_type_cd = '40' AND COALESCE(alt.apr07_stamp_yn, 'false') = 'true' ) ) ORDER BY a.apr01_reg_date DESC, apr01_appr_id DESC

/** 결재요청함 */ SELECT a.apr01_appr_id AS appr_id , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, #{companyId}, apr01_reg_date) AS status_name , a.apr01_reg_date::date AS reg_date , a.apr01_title AS title , a.next_appr_nm AS next_appr_name FROM ( SELECT a.* , '없음' as next_appr_nm FROM apr01_appr a INNER JOIN apr04_appr_step b ON a.apr01_appr_id = b.apr04_appr_id WHERE 1=1 AND a.apr01_status_cd IN ('30','40') AND b.apr04_step_status_cd IN ('20','30') AND f_trunc(apr04_appr_date) BETWEEN f_add_day(#{toDay,jdbcType=DATE}, -7) AND #{toDay,jdbcType=DATE} AND a.apr01_reg_emp_id = #{empId} UNION ALL SELECT a.* , f_get_empTrans(apr04_step_emp_id, apr01_reg_date::date, 'title_nm')||' '||f_emp_kor_nm(apr04_step_emp_id) as next_appr_nm FROM apr01_appr a INNER JOIN ( SELECT * FROM apr04_appr_step WHERE LPAD(apr04_seq,4,'0')||apr04_step_type_cd||apr04_appr_step_id IN ( SELECT MIN(LPAD(apr04_seq,4,'0')||apr04_step_type_cd||apr04_appr_step_id) FROM apr04_appr_step WHERE apr04_step_type_cd not in ('00','30') AND apr04_step_status_cd = '10' GROUP BY apr04_appr_id ) ) b ON apr01_appr_id = apr04_appr_id WHERE 1=1 AND apr01_status_cd IN ('10','20') AND apr01_reg_emp_id = #{empId} ) a ORDER BY apr01_reg_date DESC, apr01_appr_id DESC

SELECT apr01_appr_id AS appr_id , apr01_reg_date::date AS reg_date , apr01_title AS title , apr01_status_cd AS status_code FROM apr01_appr WHERE apr01_reg_emp_id = #{empId} AND apr01_company_id = #{companyId} AND COALESCE(apr01_status_cd, '00') = '99' ORDER BY apr01_reg_date DESC, apr01_appr_id DESC
